title: Accessibility review pass
when: The user asks to check a page or app for accessibility problems against WCAG 2.2 AA and wants a report of what fails.
prompt:
Goal: An audit by WCAG criterion recording each failure with the element, the criterion number, who is affected, and the fix.
Steps:
1. Static layer: alt on images, labels on controls, lang, title, heading order, unique ids, contrast pairs computed from the CSS.
2. Keyboard layer: every control reachable, visible focus (2.4.7), no trap (2.1.2), logical order (2.4.3).
3. Semantics layer: landmarks, button versus link, names on icon buttons (4.1.2), form errors identified and announced (3.3.1, 4.1.3).
4. Visual layer: text 4.5 to 1 and UI parts 3 to 1 (1.4.3, 1.4.11), reflow at 320 px (1.4.10), 200 percent zoom (1.4.4).
5. Media and motion: captions or transcripts, no autoplay sound, reduced motion honored (2.3.3).
6. Write each failure as criterion, element, impact (who cannot do what), fix; passes get one line per criterion.
Quality bar:
- Every failure cites a criterion number.
- Impact described in user terms.
- Fixes are specific markup or CSS.
Pitfalls:
- Reporting only static results.
- Recommending ARIA where a native element fixes it.
- Calling a page compliant after a partial check.
Verify:
- [ ] All five layers checked.
- [ ] Each failure has criterion and fix.
- [ ] Contrast pairs computed.
- [ ] Pass and fail counts summarized.
Output: a11y-review.md with a criteria table and the findings.

examples.input: faca uma auditoria de acessibilidade do meu site
examples.output: 1.4.3 fail: muted text 3.1 to 1 in .card p; 2.4.7 fail: outline none on links; 4.1.2 fail: icon cart button unnamed
